chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
That he disliked the hunting of the falcon, except for what has its slaughter caught (i.e., caught while being slaughtered or immediately after).
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia juristic ruling on hunting with falcons according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expressed dislike (karahah) for hunting with falcons unless the animal is caught at the precise moment of slaughter, ensuring the ritual blessing (tasmiyah) is effectively applied. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the validity of the hunter's invocation relative to the timing of the catch, distinguishing between mere capture and proper ritual slaughter.
